options.name: enabled
options.description: Whether input is enabled for touch devices.

options.name: output
options.description: The monitor to bind touch devices.

options.name: transform
options.description: Transform the input from touchdevices.

options.name: clickfinger_behavior
options.description: Button presses with 1, 2, or 3 fingers will be mapped to LMB, RMB, and MMB respectively.

options.name: disable_while_typing
options.description: Disable the touchpad while typing.

options.name: drag_3fg
options.description: Whether to use 3 or 4 finger drag.

options.name: drag_lock
options.description: When enabled, lifting the finger off while dragging will not drop the dragged item.

options.name: flip_x
options.description: Inverts the horizontal movement of the touchpad

options.name: flip_y
options.description: Inverts the vertical movement of the touchpad

options.name: middle_button_emulation
options.description: Sending LMB and RMB simultaneously will be interpreted as a middle click.

options.name: natural_scroll
options.description: Inverts scrolling direction.

options.name: scroll_factor
options.description: Multiplier applied to the amount of scroll movement.

options.name: tap-and-drag
options.description: Sets the tap and drag mode for the touchpad

options.name: tap-to-click
options.description: Tapping on the touchpad with 1, 2, or 3 fingers will send LMB, RMB, and MMB respectively.

options.name: tap_button_map
options.description: Sets the tap button mapping for touchpad button emulation. [lrm/lmr]

options.name: release_pressed_on_close
options.description: Release all pressed keys by virtual keyboard on close.

options.name: share_states
options.description: Unify key down states and modifier states with other keyboards.

options.name: allow_new_top_layers_over_existing_fullscreen
options.description: If false, newly mapped layers are not allowed to render over existing covering fullscreen window. Note that fullscreen hides all pre-existing top layers regardless of this setting

options.name: layers_hog_keyboard_focus
options.description: If true, will make keyboard-interactive layers keep their focus on mouse move.

options.name: single_window_aspect_ratio
options.description: If specified, whenever only a single window is open, it will be coerced into the specified aspect ratio.

options.name: single_window_aspect_ratio_tolerance
options.description: Minimum distance for single_window_aspect_ratio to take effect.

options.name: allow_small_split
options.description: enable adding additional master windows in a horizontal split style

options.name: always_keep_position
options.description: whether to keep the master window in its configured position when there are no slave windows

options.name: center_ignores_reserved
options.description: centers the master window on monitor ignoring reserved areas

options.name: center_master_fallback
options.description: Set fallback for center master when slaves are less than slave_count_for_center_master

options.name: drop_at_cursor
options.description: when enabled, dragging and dropping windows will put them at the cursor position.

options.name: focus_master_on_close
options.description: when enabled, closing a window focuses the master window

options.name: mfact
options.description: the size as a percentage of the master window.

options.name: new_on_active
options.description: `before`, `after`: place new window relative to the focused window; `none`: place new window according to new_on_top.

options.name: new_on_top
options.description: whether a newly open window should be on the top of the stack

options.name: new_status
options.description: `master`: new window becomes master; `slave`: new windows are added to slave stack; `inherit`: inherit from focused window

options.name: orientation
options.description: default placement of the master area

options.name: slave_count_for_center_master
options.description: when using orientation=center, make the master window centered only when at least this many slave windows are open.

options.name: smart_resizing
options.description: if enabled, resizing direction will be determined by the mouse's position on the window.

options.name: special_scale_factor
options.description: the scale of the special workspace windows.

options.name: allow_session_lock_restore
options.description: if true, will allow you to restart a lockscreen app in case it crashes.

options.name: always_follow_on_dnd
options.description: Will make mouse focus follow the mouse when drag and dropping.

options.name: animate_manual_resizes
options.description: If true, will animate manual window resizes/moves

options.name: animate_mouse_windowdragging
options.description: If true, will animate windows being dragged by mouse.

options.name: anr_missed_pings
options.description: number of missed pings before showing the ANR dialog

options.name: background_color
options.description: change the background color.

options.name: bell_sound
options.description: path to custom wav/ogg system bell. `none` or an empty string mute it. `default` uses the system's current one.

options.name: close_special_on_empty
options.description: close the special workspace if the last window is removed

options.name: col.splash
options.description: Changes the color of the splash text.

options.name: disable_autoreload
options.description: If true, the config will not reload automatically on save.

options.name: disable_hyprland_guiutils_check
options.description: disable the warning if hyprland-guiutils is missing

options.name: disable_hyprland_logo
options.description: disables the random Hyprland logo / anime girl background. :(

options.name: disable_scale_notification
options.description: disables notification popup when a monitor fails to set a suitable scale

options.name: disable_splash_rendering
options.description: disables the Hyprland splash rendering.

options.name: disable_watchdog_warning
options.description: whether to disable the warning about not using start-hyprland.

options.name: disable_xdg_env_checks
options.description: disable the warning if XDG environment is externally managed

options.name: enable_anr_dialog
options.description: whether to enable the ANR (app not responding) dialog when your apps hang

options.name: enable_swallow
options.description: Enable window swallowing

options.name: exit_window_retains_fullscreen
options.description: whether closing a fullscreen window makes the next focused window to be fullscreened

options.name: float_force_onscreen
options.description: whether existing floating windows must remain fully/partially on-screen

options.name: focus_on_activate
options.description: Whether Hyprland should focus an app that requests to be focused.

options.name: font_family
options.description: Set the global default font to render the text.

options.name: force_default_wallpaper
options.description: Force any of the 3 default wallpapers. [-1/0/1/2]

options.name: initial_workspace_token_timeout
options.description: the time in seconds a window has to open on its invoked workspace before the tracking token expires.

options.name: initial_workspace_tracking
options.description: if enabled, windows will open on the workspace they were invoked on.

options.name: key_press_enables_dpms
options.description: If DPMS is set to off, wake up the monitors if a key is pressed.

options.name: layers_hog_keyboard_focus
options.description: If true, will make keyboard-interactive layers keep their focus on mouse move.

options.name: lockdead_screen_delay
options.description: the delay in ms after the lockdead screen appears.

options.name: middle_click_paste
options.description: whether to enable middle-click-paste (aka primary selection)

options.name: mouse_move_enables_dpms
options.description: If DPMS is set to off, wake up the monitors if the mouse moves

options.name: mouse_move_focuses_monitor
options.description: Whether mouse moving into a different monitor should focus it

options.name: name_vk_after_proc
options.description: Name virtual keyboards after the processes that create them.

options.name: new_float_force_onscreen
options.description: whether new floating windows must be placed fully/partially on-screen

options.name: on_focus_under_fullscreen
options.description: if there is a fullscreen or maximized window, decide whether a tiled window requested to focus should replace it.

options.name: render_unfocused_fps
options.description: the maximum limit for renderunfocused windows' fps in the background

options.name: screencopy_force_8b
options.description: forces 8 bit screencopy

options.name: session_lock_blur
options.description: Enable blur for lockscreen. You probably want to enable `session_lock_xray`.

options.name: session_lock_xray
options.description: keep rendering workspaces below your lockscreen

options.name: size_limits_tiled
options.description: whether to apply minsize and maxsize rules to tiled windows

options.name: splash_font_family
options.description: Changes the font used to render the splash text.

options.name: swallow_exception_regex
options.description: The title regex to be used for windows that should not be swallowed.

options.name: swallow_regex
options.description: The class regex to be used for windows that should be swallowed.

options.name: vrr
options.description: controls the VRR (Adaptive Sync) of your monitors

options.name: nvidia_anti_flicker
options.description: reduces flickering on nvidia at the cost of possible frame drops on lower-end GPUs.

options.name: prefer_hdr
options.description: Prefer HDR mode.

options.name: skip_non_kms_dmabuf_formats
options.description: Do not report dmabuf formats which cannot be imported into KMS

options.name: async_commit
options.description: Submit eligible output commits asynchronously.

options.name: cm_auto_hdr
options.description: Auto-switch to hdr mode when fullscreen app is in hdr

options.name: cm_enabled
options.description: Enable Color Management pipelines (requires restart to fully take effect)

options.name: cm_sdr_eotf
options.description: Default transfer function for displaying SDR apps.

options.name: commit_timing_enabled
options.description: Enable commit timing proto. Requires restart

options.name: ctm_animation
options.description: Whether to enable a fade animation for CTM changes.

options.name: direct_scanout
options.description: Enables direct scanout.

options.name: expand_undersized_textures
options.description: Whether to expand textures that have not yet resized to be larger.

options.name: fp16_sdr_tf
options.description: Internal workbuffer transfer function for fp16 in SDR mode

options.name: icc_vcgt_enabled
options.description: Enable sending VCGT ramps to KMS with ICC profiles

options.name: keep_unmodified_copy
options.description: Keep umodified SDR frame copy for sreensharing.

options.name: new_render_scheduling
options.description: enable new render scheduling, which should improve FPS on underpowered devices.

options.name: non_shader_cm
options.description: Enable CM without shader.

options.name: non_shader_cm_interop
options.description: non_shader_cm interaction with ctm proto (hyprsunset and similar).

options.name: not_shown_fifo_lock
options.description: Control fifo locking for not shown surfaces. always - use fifo lock for any surface, ignore_unfocused - ignore render_unfocused windows, never - skip locking invisible surfaces

options.name: send_content_type
options.description: Report content type to allow monitor profile autoswitch

options.name: use_fp16
options.description: Use experimental internal FP16 buffer.

options.name: use_shader_blur_blend
options.description: Use experimental blurred bg blending

options.name: xp_mode
options.description: Disable back buffer and bottom layer rendering.

options.name: column_width
options.description: the default width of a column.

options.name: direction
options.description: Direction in which new windows appear and the layout scrolls

options.name: explicit_column_widths
options.description: A comma-separated list of preconfigured widths for colresize +conf/-conf

options.name: focus_fit_method
options.description: When a column is focused, what method should be used to bring it into view

options.name: follow_focus
options.description: Behaviour of the scrolling tape when a window is in focus. 0: Focus doesn't cause tape move. 1: Focus may cause tape move, mouse click always moves the tape. 2: Focus may cause tape move.

options.name: follow_min_visible
options.description: when a window is focused, require that at least a given fraction of it is visible for focus to follow

options.name: fullscreen_on_one_column
options.description: when enabled, a single column on a workspace will always span the entire screen.

options.name: wrap_focus
options.description: Determines if column focus wraps around

options.name: wrap_swapcol
options.description: Determines if column movement wraps around

options.name: create_abstract_socket
options.description: Create the abstract Unix domain socket for XWayland

options.name: enabled
options.description: allow running applications using X11

options.name: force_zero_scaling
options.description: forces a scale of 1 on xwayland windows on scaled displays.

options.name: use_nearest_neighbor
options.description: uses the nearest neighbor filtering for xwayland apps, making them pixelated rather than blurry
